5. After a correct verdict, save the verified transform at `programs/<task id>.py`, replacing any older version, then finish.

Validate parsing and panel geometry explicitly: locate the divider and identify panel bounds/orientation from the input; do not infer layout from color counts alone. Avoid hardcoded colors or guessed majority rules unless demos establish them.
